partition.condition: two or more heirs named, holdings >= 4
partition.effect: The senior heir takes the seat and the contiguous core; the junior heir founds a cadet house of the same community and tag in the outer holdings, with a "kin" relation to the parent.

triggers: a disorderly succession finds no successor (roll: 20% chance of no successor)
extinction.escheat: Holdings escheat to unclaimed unless a ◉+ or kin partner exists, in which case that partner may absorb them (Absorb roll at +3).
extinction.record: The removed house remains in the record with its full history.

heirs.second_heir_effect: naming a second heir raises cohesion +3 now and enables partition later

contraction_sale.effect: must sell one non-seat riding to an adjacent house with capital >= 50 (or to the Crown, which returns it to unclaimed) at the event's resolution

debt.trigger: capital below 0 for three consecutive seasons
debt.effect: forces a sale as in contraction_sale

disorderly_succession.effect: loses its most recently acquired non-seat riding to unclaimed
disorderly_succession.note: represents contested wills and Crown review

losing_ridings.seat_riding_rule: The seat riding is only ever lost by challenge, absorption or extinction.

enclosure.definition: A house is enclosed when no unclaimed riding is land-adjacent to any of its holdings.
effects: Purchase, Marriage alliance, Absorb, Cede/swap and Challenge gain the enclosure bonus (see rules/actions.csv enclosure_bonus column, where stated)
Cultivate influence, Endow and Petition elevation weights double
Ambition drifts +1 every 10 enclosed seasons for Conservative and Mixed houses; -1 every 10 enclosed seasons for Progressive houses

Fully surrounded houses that also have cohesion < 40 draw a "Siege" objective: survive 10 seasons without losing a riding, or seek a protector (Marriage alliance / compact) with the strongest neighbour
enclosure.map_full_behaviour: When the map is full (no unclaimed riding anywhere), founding stops by itself. The engine of change becomes succession: disorderly successions, partitions and extinctions return ridings to play or redistribute them, and founding resumes wherever land reopens. Regional fullness is tracked so that the Prairies can be in a land-rush while Nova Scotia is already in its dynastic phase.
